mustFix.ruling: Owner decisions 2026-10-27 (system review, portfolio-evidence/loop-audit/SYSTEM-REVIEW-2026-10-13.md): website-first is reaffirmed (the Manor/project ion stays paused until the portfolio is live). The review's lean pre-launch crew model is ADOPTED for W-S2 onward: pre-launch must-fix taxonomy (block on acceptance-row failures, regressions vs main on default visitor paths, reproduced budget breaches, and slice design rows below target; pre-existing, rare-edge and tooling items go here by default); timed perf once per PR at the approval candidate plus once before G3a; 1 breaker pass by default (2 for W-F-m3); a design/motion jury with must-fix power on slices; waits of 270 s or less; a small versioned spec per crew. W-S2 cap: 3 code rounds plus 1 evidence round. No budget pause; each round still reports its cost. Slot 2's tooling PR now implements the review's quick wins before W-S2 launches.

ws2.title: the work index (contact sheet): three enlargements and the proof sheet with its List

jury.scale: 0 to 10 against the named references in the motion benchmark: 10 matches the best of them in quality (never their look), 7 is at the bar, 5 is competent but generic

rows.row: Enlargement entry and develop (spec L3, M1): each enlargement lies down with scroll and develops once at 35% visible over 2,400 ms, reading as a print coming up in the tray, not a fade (refs: leo-parpeix scroll.webm 0 to 2.2 s; pensatori-irrazionali scroll_sheet.png)

Proof sheet wave (spec L3): the prints develop as one wave, 60 ms apart, all done by 2.1 s, the grain calm and forming once (refs: portfolio-zxc intro-sheet-wave.png; gionatan-nese intro.webm staggers)

Sheet and List switch (spec T1, T2, L5): one move; wet prints snap to developed in frame 0 before the 160 ms crossfade; the 180 ms swell with no row-height change; rapid toggles follow the swap rate without a flicker (refs: gionatan-nese hover.webm)

The table at rest (spec L1, L2, L6): the enlargements and the sheet read as one darkroom light table at every band, with W-D031 sizes, offsets and tilts and D-025 rebate tokens; never a card grid or a template (refs: jesper-landberg hover.webm at rest; guillaume-colombel scroll-sheet.png)
Hover lift (spec H1): the print answers on itself within about 100 ms (50% by about 90 ms), GL only, fine pointer, never on keyboard focus (refs: jesper-landberg hover.webm)

the hero's readable time: hero:readable minus stage:gl-ready <= 3300 ms, median of 3 cold loads (budgets.md Hero)
